name: Maple Ridge Townhomes
text:
Rent
- Starting rent is "$965/month," described as "Subject to availability."
- The sample listing shows "$965 /month" for an 11-month term, moving in 1 Sep, 2026 and out 31 Jul, 2027.

Fees
- Application fee: "Application Fee: $50" (one-time).
- Tech fee: "$90 Tech Fee (New Residents)" yearly, or "$75 (Renewals)."
- Insurance premium: "$17 Insurance Premium" monthly. Residents can opt out with their own third-party insurance.
- Credit builder: "$8 Credit Builder" monthly. Residents can opt out.
- Utility billing: monthly fees from the third-party provider Simple Bills, with no amount listed.
- Late fees: not charged until after the 5th of the month, with no amount listed.

Deposits and guarantor options
- Opting out of a guarantor requires either a deposit of "2-month installment" or the Guarantor Waiver Program.
- The Guarantor Waiver Program involves an additional monthly fee, "subject to change by year and property," plus a "$300 deposit."

Included or unclear
- Internet and pest control are included in the monthly rent.
- Water, sewer, and electric appear under "Bills Included," but the FAQ says utilities are billed monthly through Simple Bills.
notes: No official property website found in search. Text is from a third-party student-housing aggregator; the WebFetch model refused full verbatim copy (quote-length limit), so dollar amounts are quoted but surrounding wording is the fetch model's paraphrase. Page itself flags a contradiction: utilities listed as 'Bills Included' but FAQ says billed monthly via Simple Bills.
